errors.name: SegmentNotFound
errors.description: No sealed segment exists for the given name.

segment.description: The sealed segment filename, e.g. seg_000000002a.jss.

blockIndex.description: Zero-based block index within the segment. Must be < the segment's block_count.

main.description: Download a single block within a sealed segment file by index. Returns the raw zstd-compressed block frame exactly as stored on disk.
